items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: At any rate, it was just like that fight, that Gerry Cooney fight, you know.

ctx.x: Although Joe Smith used to play some pretty things.

Oh yeah. Also the other Smith, Russell Smith, used to play "Time On My Hands" and ...[?]... They played pretty things. But so could the White bands play pretty things. And that just wasn't my thing, you know.

You got to watch saying that, now, because we'll get another Leonard Feather deal going on here! Boy, that cat really hung me on the wall with that. Boy, that was really wrong, man.
